description:
JSONPlaceholder is a mock API: it does not validate input and echoes payloads with 201.
  The suite asserts the contract that matters: no server-side (5xx) failures, and records actual behaviour.

elements.name: Excessively long title does not cause a server error

steps.name: I POST a post with a title of 10000 characters
the response status is not a server error
the response is either a client error or an echo of the payload
I POST a post with title "<script>alert(1)</script>"
the response status is not a server error
the response is either a client error or an echo of the payload
I POST a post with title "'; DROP TABLE posts; --"
the response status is not a server error
the response is either a client error or an echo of the payload
I POST a post with title "Unicode ✓ é 日本 %00 {{7*7}}"
the response status is not a server error
the response is either a client error or an echo of the payload

elements.name: Missing userId is handled without server failure

steps.name: I POST a post without a userId
the response status is not a server error
the response is either a client error or an echo of the payload
